note: Phase 5 owns 205 function rows and 122 data objects. Five function rows are closed by registered staged-pair mutations: phys_fn_002318, phys_fn_000030, phys_fn_000032, phys_fn_000034, and phys_fn_002421. One row, phys_fn_001391, is closed by the NxPhysicsShapeVtableTests oracle/candidate check. 199 function rows remain reconstructed but not falsified, none remain unreconstructed, and no data object is dispositioned. The ledger accounts for all 205 function rows; the 122 data objects remain separately classified as described by their inventory records. See evidence/shape-self-001391.md.

proof_kinds.differential_falsified: mutations aimed at the five staged-pair rows were caught by their registered differentials; 199 reconstructed function rows still need a mutation and measured detection.
proof_kinds.static_proof_falsified: a mutation aimed at the row and caught by a static check rather than a differential. This phase has none yet.
proof_kinds.oracle_differential_falsified: the mutation to phys_fn_001391 was caught by NxPhysicsShapeVtableTests, which compares the candidate Box vtable identity call with the pinned oracle; the non-zero mismatch count records the failed identity case.

deferred_reasons.not_reconstructed_in_phase: this phase did not reconstruct this row and names nothing that blocks it. A debt, not an obstruction; no function rows remain here.
deferred_reasons.reconstructed_not_falsified: the row is reconstructed and carries a recorded proof, but no mutation has been aimed at it. This is the work the phase has left: 199 rows, each needing one mutation and one measured detection.
deferred_reasons.data_object_not_dispositioned: no closure schema lets any phase close a data object, so the data half arrives here by construction.

entry_points: the census rows this phase owns, by rva

falsification.mutation: In an isolated git-archive copy, removed the predecessor-link assignment in NxSceneInternal::releaseController, leaving the released middle controller linked from the surviving head.
In nxActorDestroy, omitted deletion of the actor root after recycling its actor ID.
Omitted the mesh case's Scene+0x10 increment and mesh-count-driven Scene buffer reserve from nxActorShapeFactory.
Omitted the copy from NxActorDescBase::userData to NxActor::userData in nxActorLoadFromDescInternal after registering the actor.
Omitted the indexed record-pointer write in nxSceneAuxRegisterRecord while preserving ID allocation and active-list bookkeeping.
In a throwaway git archive copy, changed BoxShape::nxBoxSelf from returning this to returning null; the Box slot-14 oracle/candidate identity check was the single failing case.
